findings.evidence: The form's task is account creation. Preferred contact time is an optional user preference that does not need to be collected during initial account setup.
findings.fix: Remove this field from account creation and ask for it later when setting up contact preferences or communication settings
findings.violation: Preferred contact time is not necessary to create an account; this preference could be asked later or set as a default in account settings

findings.evidence: Both fields have autocomplete="name" and request the person's name without clarification that one is for legal purposes and the other is for display purposes
findings.fix: Remove one of the duplicate name fields, or clarify their distinct purposes (legal vs. display) if both are genuinely needed
findings.violation: Form asks for the same information twice: full name at #name-input and your name at #legalname-input, both required fields with identical autocomplete token

findings.evidence: The form's task is account creation (heading: Set up your account, button: Create account). Shipping speed preference is not part of establishing an account.
findings.fix: Remove this field from account creation flow and ask for shipping preference later when the person places their first order
findings.violation: Preferred shipping speed is not necessary to create an account; this preference could be asked later during order placement or set as a default in account preferences
